page.layout: One printed page (left-hand text column), with running head at top; a partial facing page at the right edge with a few cut-off words in the right margin, not transcribed as text. Main text block: running paragraph, a centred-ish block of prayer, a centred heading in capitals and a closing line. Below, a small ornament with a bracketed letter and a faint word "Amen" at the right foot.

main_text.p: cinianorum acturi sumus, si Deo ita visum fuerit.

Rogamus vero Deum Opt. Max. ut is tandem aliquando suae Eccle‑siae misereatur, & tollat dissensiones magno multorum piorum scandalo circa hoc Sacrosanctum mysterium enatas, ut tandem aliquando majori concordiâ & consensu sanctum ipsius nomen inter nos celebretur, charitas crescat, & cum ipso simul, ac inter nos magis magisque uniamur. Da Deus salutem, da prosperitatem. Amen.
main_text.head: REGI SECULORUM IMMORTALI, invisibili, soli Deo, honor & gloria in secula seculorum. Amen.

page.notes: The facing page at the right edge is cut off and only partly legible; its text is not transcribed. The ornament with the bracketed letter below the heading is printed as shown. The word "Amen" at the lower right is a marginal or catchword-like print and is uncertain. Several words in the body are blurred by show-through and staining (e.g. "Ecclesiae", "charitas", "inter"), read with best judgement and not individually marked.
